"Create a complete, fully playable 3D political satire fighting game inspired by Sansad Showdown: The Great Kursi Fight. The game must have original implementation, professional-quality graphics and complete gameplay.

GAME TYPE:
Third-person 3D arena fighting game with single-player, local multiplayer and online multiplayer modes.

GRAPHICS:
Target AAA-quality visuals comparable to modern console fighting games. Realistic PBR materials, detailed character models, realistic skin, cloth and hair, high-quality textures, realistic shadows, global illumination, reflections, ambient occlusion, cinematic lighting, particle effects, motion blur and high-quality environmental details.

GAME SIZE:
Target final Android game size 500–600 MB. Use optimized 3D models, high-quality textures, audio, animations and compressed assets. Do not create empty filler files just to reach the size.

ENVIRONMENTS:
Build a detailed Indian Parliament-inspired fictional fighting arena, with parliamentary seating, speaker podium, wooden furniture, architectural details, decorative lights, large audience seating and animated spectators. Include multiple original arenas.

CHARACTERS:
Add EXACTLY these 9 requested characters:
1. Narendra Modi
2. Yogi Adityanath
3. Nitin Gadkari
4. Ravi Kishan
5. Lalu Prasad Yadav
6. Rahul Gandhi
7. Mamata Banerjee
8. Mahatma Gandhi
9. Donald Trump

Remove all previously suggested fictional characters. Do not add extra playable characters. Create recognizable, respectful, clearly fictionalized satirical 3D game representations of all nine people. Give each a distinct costume, appearance, fighting style, idle animation, special moves and victory animation. Mahatma Gandhi should have a playful historical-inspired non-violent representation.

GAMEPLAY:
Include punch, kick, block, dodge, grab, combos, special attacks, stamina, health bars, knockback and responsive hit reactions. Smooth transitions and responsive controls.

MODES:
1. Story Mode
2. Quick Fight
3. Tournament Mode
4. 1v1 Mode
5. Multiplayer Mode
6. Training Mode

MOBILE CONTROLS:
Virtual joystick on left, punch, kick, block, dodge and special attack buttons on right. Add camera control and controller support.

ANIMATIONS:
High-quality fighting animations, idle animations, walking, running, jumping, attacking, blocking, falling, getting up and victory poses.

AUDIO:
Original background music, arena ambience, audience reactions, fictional character voice lines, hit sounds and menu sounds.

AI:
Create intelligent CPU opponents with multiple difficulty levels, tactical attacks, blocking, dodging and combos.

ANDROID OPTIMIZATION:
Target Android 15, 64-bit ARM devices. Include adjustable graphics settings, low/medium/high/ultra presets, stable frame rate, optimized memory usage, loading screens and pause menu.

UI:
Create a polished professional fighting game interface with character selection, arena selection, health bars, settings, game modes, loading screen and main menu.

DELIVERABLE:
Build the complete working game, not a prototype or mockup. Include all source files, assets, project configuration, Android build configuration and a properly signed release APK. Test gameplay, controls, collisions, menus, loading and Android compatibility. Fix errors before delivery.

IMPORTANT:
Do not leave placeholder characters, missing textures, unfinished buttons or fake gameplay. Every advertised feature must actually work. If a feature cannot be implemented, clearly report it rather than pretending it works.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- The original request called for nine named characters, multiple arenas, six game modes, combat, keyboard/touch/controller controls, AI, audio, polished UI, Android optimization/build, and a signed release APK.

- Test gameplay and menus, and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

- Built an original browser game with Three.js and procedural graphics in the sparse repository.
- Online matchmaking is not implemented; do not present it as available.

- Implemented a browser game with nine character choices, three arena choices, combat, CPU AI, local/training/mode selections, synthesized sound effects, menus, HUD, pause/results, and responsive touch controls.

- Capture/inspect a current small JPEG screenshot if needed after final fixes.

- Online multiplayer, native Android/Android 15 build configuration and signed APK are not implemented.
- AAA-quality assets and controller support have not been implemented or verified.

# Sansad Showdown — The Great Kursi Fight

A small, browser-based 3D political-satire arena brawler. Choose a debater and arena, then fight a CPU opponent, practice, or play a local two-player match. It uses Three.js from jsDelivr and procedural 3D scenery and character models.

## Run locally

From this directory, start any static HTTP server, for example:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Open <http://localhost:8000> in a modern browser. An internet connection is required to load Three.js and the web fonts from their CDNs. No build step or package installation is needed. The supplied `start.sh` is an OMGithub runtime entrypoint and expects its `RUNTIME_DIR` environment variable; it is not the general-purpose local run command above.

## Controls

- **Player 1:** WASD to move, J to punch, K to kick, L or Shift to block, Space to dodge, E for a special, Esc to pause.
- **Player 2 (Local 1v1):** Arrow keys to move, numpad 1/2 to punch/kick, numpad 3 or Right Shift to block, Enter to dodge, numpad 0 for a special.
- **Touch:** On-screen movement and action buttons are available on touch devices.

## What's implemented

- Nine character selections, three arenas, and a 3D fight scene with health, stamina, timer, synthesized sound effects, CPU opponent, pause/results panels, and responsive touch controls.
- Quick Fight, Story, Tournament, Local 1v1, and Training selections. Story and Tournament provide lightweight sequential CPU fights rather than a full narrative or competitive bracket.
- Online Multiplayer appears in the mode menu but is not connected to matchmaking; selecting it displays an unavailable notice.

## Limitations

This is a web prototype, not a finished mobile release. There is no native Android project, Android 15 configuration, signed APK, online backend, or verified controller support. Characters, crowd, arenas, and sound are procedural/simple prototype assets rather than production-quality authored assets. Browser support and performance vary by device; no mobile-device optimization or release build has been verified.
